chunks: The worst of creatures in the eyes of God are those who are deaf and dumb and devoid of sense.

key_terms.الصُّمُّ: The deaf (those who do not listen to truth)
key_terms.الْبُكْمُ: The dumb (those who do not speak truth)

ai.seo_question: Who are considered the worst of creatures in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as describing those who possess the physical faculties of hearing and speech but fail to utilize their intellect ('aql) to recognize divine truth, rendering them spiritually inert. The term 'dawabb' (creatures/beasts) emphasizes their sub-human status due to this deficiency in rational comprehension, a theme central to the concept of 'Aql in Shia theology. This metaphor underscores the necessity of active intellectual engagement with revelation, distinguishing mere biological existence from true spiritual awareness.
